address: 22 Tran Quoc Toan Street, Ward 8, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, 72408, Vietnam
bio: The decor is unmistakably Hội An in style – yellow walls, lanterns and wooden furniture. The menu is easy to navigate, with mì quảng noodles and cơm gà chicken rice being the main events. Trouble choosing? Try the mì quảng đặc biệt topped with shrimp, pork, quail egg, ham, fermented pork roll and peanut spring roll. Cơm gà xé comprises silky shredded chicken, onion and laksa leaves on a bed of chicken fat rice, with chicken offal sauce on the side....
